review: The TechPro X200 headset delivers amazing sound clarity and the noise cancellation is top-notch.
Battery life could be better—lasts only about 4 hours on a full charge.
Comfortable to wear for long sessions, and the mic pickup is crystal clear for calls.
Had connection dropouts with my laptop; had to keep re-pairing via Bluetooth.
Sleek design, easy to use controls, and fast charging—overall a solid purchase.
